events.text: Hana: Could you remind me what the repair drive needs and when it’s happening?
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Dane: I’m sorry, I don’t have the details yet—could you send me the list and time again?
events.speaker: Dane

events.text: Hana: Sure — I’ll send the repair list and the time again so we’re both set.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Nell: Thanks, Dane — I’ve just been hearing bits and pieces, so I’d really appreciate the update. If you learn the date or what they still need, I’m happy to help out.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Dane: I’m still waiting on the full repair list and exact time, but I’ll send it as soon as I get it. Thanks — I’ll keep you posted.
events.speaker: Dane

events.text: Nell: Thanks, Dane — I appreciate it. Just send me the update when you have it, and I’m happy to help wherever you need me.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word that the repair drive meets at the community center parking lot.
events.speaker: Jules

prov.value: The repair drive is being held on Sunday at the community center.

events.text: Dane: Thanks, Jules — that works for me. Could you also send the repair list again when you get a chance?

events.text: Rosa: Got it — the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, and I’ll keep everyone updated with the priority list and timeline.
events.speaker: Rosa
